description.value:
You've constructed a sophisticated program synchronized with your brain that you can use to remotely control a complex device of your own design. This program and its linked device are collectively called an exocortex. The exocortex is immune to the glitching condition, but the linked device is not.

At 1st level, you choose your exocortex. The exocortexes presented in this book include the following: a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.Drone], a network of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.Mine]{Mines}, or a deployable @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.Turret]. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Modify] your exocortex in unique ways.
